### MouseMode

Source: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea/v2@v2.0.0-beta.6

MouseMode represents the mouse mode of a view. It defines constants for disabling mouse events, enabling cell motion, and enabling all motion.

```APIDOC
## MouseMode

### Description
MouseMode represents the mouse mode of a view.

### Constants
- **MouseModeNone** - Disables mouse events.
- **MouseModeCellMotion** - Enables mouse click, release, and wheel events. Mouse movement events are also captured if a mouse button is pressed (i.e., drag events). Cell motion mode is better supported than all motion mode. This will try to enable the mouse in extended mode (SGR), if that is not supported by the terminal it will fall back to normal mode (X10).
- **MouseModeAllMotion** - Enables all mouse events, including click, release, wheel, and movement events. You will receive mouse movement events even when no buttons are pressed. This will try to enable the mouse in extended mode (SGR), if that is not supported by the terminal it will fall back to normal mode (X10).
```

--------------------------------

### type MouseButton

Source: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea

MouseButton represents the button that was pressed during a mouse event. It is based on X11 mouse button codes.

```APIDOC
## type MouseButton

### Description
MouseButton represents the button that was pressed during a mouse event.

### Constants
```go
const (
	MouseButtonNone MouseButton = iota
	MouseButtonLeft
	MouseButtonMiddle
	MouseButtonRight
	MouseButtonWheelUp
	MouseButtonWheelDown
	MouseButtonWheelLeft
	MouseButtonWheelRight
	MouseButtonBackward
	MouseButtonForward
	MouseButton10
	MouseButton11
)
```

Mouse event buttons

This is based on X11 mouse button codes.

```
1 = left button
2 = middle button (pressing the scroll wheel)
3 = right button
4 = turn scroll wheel up
5 = turn scroll wheel down
6 = push scroll wheel left
7 = push scroll wheel right
8 = 4th button (aka browser backward button)
9 = 5th button (aka browser forward button)
10
11
```

Other buttons are not supported.
```

### func WithMouseCellMotion() ProgramOption

Source: https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/charmbracelet/bubbletea

Starts the program with the mouse enabled in 'cell motion' mode, capturing click, release, wheel, and drag events. Falls back to normal mode if extended mode is unsupported.

```APIDOC
## func WithMouseCellMotion() ProgramOption

### Description
Starts the program with the mouse enabled in "cell motion" mode. Cell motion mode enables mouse click, release, and wheel events. Mouse movement events are also captured if a mouse button is pressed (i.e., drag events). Cell motion mode is better supported than all motion mode. This will try to enable the mouse in extended mode (SGR), if that is not supported by the terminal it will fall back to normal mode (X10). To enable mouse cell motion once the program has already started running use the EnableMouseCellMotion command. To disable the mouse when the program is running use the DisableMouse command. The mouse will be automatically disabled when the program exits.

### Method
N/A (Go function)

### Endpoint
N/A

### Parameters
None

### Response
None
```
